sources.excerpt: Ibanez SM7 Smashbox | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Distortion / Ibanez SM7 Smashbox SM7 Smashbox The Ibanez SM7 Smashbox is a versatile distortion effects pedal from the Tone-Lok series, delivering an aggressive and modern heavy rock sound. With its obscene amounts of gain, tight low end, and searing highs, it's designed for contemporary guitarists seeking a powerful and modern distortion sound. The SM7 features a scooped mid-range, ultra-tight low-end, and searing highs, ensuring a heavy sound suitable for metal, punk, and industrial rock. What guitarists say... Guitarists found the Ibanez SM7 Smashbox to be a good distortion pedal for metal, punk, and industrial rock. They particularly appreciated its built-in noise gate. SM7 Smashbox compared to ...
